question: Shyamlal lends some money at simple interest. He adds interest every six months to calculate the principal. If he is charging 5% interest, what will be the effective annual interest rate (correct to two decimal places)?
solution:
Formula used:

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Amount = P + S.I

Here,

P = Sum,T = Time & R = Rate

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be 100x

So, Interest for 1st 6 months = (100x × 5 × 6
